newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic sets direct stock buy plan.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic sets direct stock buy plan.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said Tuesday it introduced a new plan under which investors can bypass brokers and purchase common stock directly from the company.
New investors can buy shares of Bell Atlantic stock under the plan with an initial investment of $1,000 or more. Additional purchases can be made for a $50 minimum, Bell Atlantic said.

In addition to direct stock purchases, investors will be able to reinvest quarterly dividends; buy additional shares and pay by check or through automatic monthly deductions; establish an Individual Retirement Account of Bell Atlantic stock; deposit their Bell Atlantic stock certificates with the Bell Atlantic transfer agent at no charge; and sell Bell Atlantic shares through the company without broker's charges.
The company will charge a one-time enrollment fee of $5. The fee for reinvesting dividends is five percent of the amount invested with a minimum charge of $1 and a maximum charge of $2.
